chunks: Or do they have a god apart from God? He is too exalted for what they associate with Him!

key_terms.سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ: Glory be to Allah / Exalted is Allah

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Allah's transcendence from polytheism?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah At-Tur, this verse serves as a rhetorical challenge to the polytheists of Mecca, contrasting their fabricated idols with the singular, transcendent Creator. Shia scholarship emphasizes the 'Subhanallah' declaration here as an affirmation of Allah's absolute purity from any anthropomorphic or associative limitations, reinforcing the foundational principle of Tawhid al-Asma wa al-Sifat.
